title: Upstate NY mayor 'lying' about gas station dispute, Seneca Nation leader says
summary: The Seneca Nation is proceeding with a $10 million gas station development project in Buffalo despite disputes with the city over municipal authority. A Seneca Nation leader has publicly rejected the mayor's position on the city's ability to halt construction, characterizing claims as false. This represents an ongoing intergovernmental and land-use conflict between tribal and municipal jurisdictions.

political_signal.description: Tribal sovereignty and municipal authority in conflict; Seneca Nation directly challenging city's jurisdictional claims and proceeding despite municipal objections
